note: Inputs of the phase 6c single-photo measurements (tools/edge_radii/run_all.py). Lines and seeds were drawn by eye on gridded display-orientation crops (EXIF applied) and every result was checked by eye on its crop/overlay. pxmm = native px per mm at the edge, from the tape in the same photo (tools/edge_radii/tick.py, refined on the 2-16 period peaks), except where noted.

1493.how: tick.py 1493, first half of a line along the tape (the whole line crosses the hook)

1495.how: tick.py 1495 1080 1450 1350 1330, first half (the whole line doubles the period on the 1/8 marks)

1495_nose.how: rocker width 30.5 mm (PR #32 tape) over the 430 px top edge of the nose end face; +-10 %

bands.what: crest top edge from behind, rear arris (highlight band)
bands.by_eye: a real highlight band: a bright line peaking 0.2 mm inside the silhouette, back to the face by 0.9 mm; r about 0.9-1.8

bands.what: crest bottom edge from behind, over the gap between slats only (shade band)
bands.by_eye: a real shade band on the wood side, about 1 mm wide; r about 1.1-2.2

bands.what: centre slat left edge just under the crest, from behind
bands.by_eye: wood is the textured darker side; a shade band about 0.6 mm wide, ten times a sharpening halo; r about 0.7-1.3

bands.what: back leg rear face, outer arris
bands.by_eye: wood is the dark textured side; a faint lighter band about 0.7 mm wide inside a crisp silhouette (the smooth slope on the other side is the background); r about 0.7-1.5

bands.what: back leg rear face, inner arris
bands.by_eye: wood is the dark textured side; no band beyond the blur (0.6 mm); r <= about 1.2

bands.what: front leg front face, right-hand arris just above the rocker
bands.by_eye: wood is the dark textured side; a slight highlight about 0.6 mm wide, close to the blur (0.5 mm); r about 0.6-1.1

corners.what: front rocker nose end face seen nearly end-on: its top-outer corner is the section of the top/outer arris
right rocker rear tip from above: corner between the end and a side face, in plan
the other plan corner of the same tip (partly against the tape; the fitted arc sits on the end just past the corner, so it is a soft upper bound)
